units: uu, UE axes (X fwd, Y right, Z up); origin at ground level centred between the axles
wheel_mesh_note: SM_Wheel_W03_Lug is authored as a left wheel (hub face to UE -Y); yaw right wheels 180 deg.

feature.mesh_origin: SM_Navvy_Blade vertices are relative to the hinge: attach the blade component at 'hinge' with zero rotation; at pitch 0 it sits in its rest pose.
feature.sign: UE FRotator pitch, positive raises the blade (cutting edge moves up and forward)
feature.push_face: concave moldboard, front x 70.9-78.4, z 1.5-25.3 at rest

lamp_tint: Body vertex colour 'Col' on Lamp faces: white = clear (head/work lamps), red = tail lamps, amber = roof beacon. Multiply in the Lamp material.
axles: steel axles are part of SM_Navvy_Body (slot Zamac) at x = +/-33, z = 14, |y| <= 41.8, radius 1.0; the two rivet heads under the base are also Body/Zamac (bare metal).

uv.UV0: smart unwrap per part, non-overlapping (wear, grain, chips)
uv.UV1_body_windows: tampo layout from a fixed box x[-64,64] y[-44,44] z[0,50] uu (Blender axes): left side U 0-0.5 (front at U 0, as seen from the left), right side U 0.5-1 (front at U 1), sides V 0-0.64 by height; top strip V 0.68-1 (U rear->front, V right->left seen from above); front/rear/underside faces in the blank band V 0.64-0.68
uv.UV1_blade: front projection of the push face U 0-1 across the width as seen from the front, V 0-0.6 by height; arm sides V 0.62-1 (left U 0-0.5, right U 0.5-1)
uv.UV1_base: projection from below, readable from below with the front to the right: U rear->front, V left->right; moulded text area is the plain panel x[-24.2,22.2] y[-13.7,13.7] uu inside the raised border (base text decal goes there)
